landing.heroTitle: Connecting disaster victims, donors, and volunteers — in real time
landing.heroSubtitle: A centralized platform for requesting, tracking, and delivering disaster relief across Sri Lanka, with full transparency from request to delivery.
landing.step1Desc: A victim describes what they need — food, water, medicine — and where, in under a minute.
landing.step2Desc: Donations are matched to the highest-priority nearby request, and a volunteer is assigned.
landing.step3Desc: The volunteer delivers, and the victim confirms receipt — closing the loop with full transparency.
landing.affectedAreasDesc: Where aid requests are concentrated right now, by district — public information, updated live.
landing.forVictimsDesc: Submit a structured aid request in seconds, tracked from submission to delivery.
landing.forDonorsDesc: Register donations and see exactly where they go, with delivery confirmation.
landing.forVolunteersDesc: Get matched to nearby deliveries and track progress from pickup to confirmation.

footer.tagline: A centralized platform connecting disaster victims, donors, and volunteers, built as a BSc Software Engineering dissertation project.
footer.dataSourcesText: Emergency warnings and river-gauge levels shown on this site are sourced from the Disaster Management Centre (DMC) and Department of Irrigation, Sri Lanka. River-gauge data is pulled directly from the Department of Irrigation's own public real-time gauge network.
footer.disclaimer: Built for research and evaluation purposes. Not an official government platform.

severityMap.title: Affected Area Severity — Sri Lanka
severityMap.description: "Areas Affected" shows how much aid-request activity is concentrated in each district — a district-level summary, not individual request locations, to protect the people who submitted them. "River Levels" shows live gauge readings against flood thresholds.
severityMap.unofficialData: Live data from the Department of Irrigation's own public gauge network.
severityMap.noWarnings: No active DMC warnings right now.
severityMap.gdacsCaption: Tropical cyclone tracking and general disaster events from the Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System (EC Joint Research Centre), filtered to ones relevant to Sri Lanka.
severityMap.gdacsNoEvents: No GDACS-tracked events relevant to Sri Lanka right now.
severityMap.earthquakesTitle: Regional Seismic Activity — Tsunami Risk Indicator
severityMap.earthquakesCaption: Recent magnitude 4.0+ earthquakes from the US Geological Survey, across the Indian Ocean / Bay of Bengal / Sumatra subduction zone — the region that produced the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami. Sri Lanka itself sits on stable crust and rarely has local seismic activity; this tracks the wider zone as an early-context indicator, not a Sri Lanka earthquake feed.
severityMap.earthquakesNoEvents: No magnitude 4.0+ earthquakes in the region in the last 30 days.
severityMap.earthquakesNoEventsSriLanka: No magnitude 4.0+ earthquakes within Sri Lanka's immediate waters in the last 30 days — expected most days.
severityMap.communityReportsCaption: Road closures and water/flood conditions reported by volunteers in the field and verified by an admin before appearing here.
severityMap.communityReportsNoReports: No verified community reports right now.
severityMap.weatherCaption: Live conditions from OpenWeatherMap across Sri Lanka's main regions — useful context alongside the river-gauge and DMC data above, since heavy rain is often the earliest signal of flood risk.
severityMap.reservoirsCaption: Describes current officially-reported state only — never a prediction of when a gate might open. Two separate operators, two separate feeds, shown as distinct groups.
severityMap.reservoirsIrrigationCaption: Daily storage % and spilling status, from the Irrigation Department's own published bulletin.
severityMap.reservoirsHydroCaption: Level (MSL) and active storage %, from CEB's Mahaweli Complex daily 6:00 AM bulletin — a separate operator from the Irrigation Department above.
severityMap.reservoirsHydroUnavailable: Hydropower reservoir data is temporarily unavailable.
severityMap.reservoirsNoFlagged: No reservoirs currently at elevated storage.
severityMap.reservoirsMapCaption: Kotmale, Victoria, and Randenigala (CEB/Mahaweli hydropower reservoirs) have real coordinates, shown in their risk color. The 109 Irrigation Department reservoirs have no location data in their source bulletin at all, so they're shown in light pink at their district's centroid — click a pin for its actual risk level and details.
severityMap.reservoirsMapUnavailable: Reservoir location data is temporarily unavailable.
severityMap.reservoirsApproxNote: Approximate location — district centroid, not the real pin.
